using System;
using System.IO;
using Emby.Server.Implementations.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests.IO
{
    public class LibraryMonitorTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void StartWatchingPath_ThrowsException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<LibraryMonitor>>();
            var libraryManagerMock = new Mock<ILibraryManager>();
            var configManagerMock = new Mock<IServerConfigurationManager>();
            var fileSystemMock = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
            var appLifetimeMock = new Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime>();
            var dotIgnoreMock = new Mock<DotIgnoreIgnoreRule>();

            var monitor = new LibraryMonitor(
                loggerMock.Object,
                libraryManagerMock.Object,
                configManagerMock.Object,
                fileSystemMock.Object,
                appLifetimeMock.Object,
                dotIgnoreMock.Object);

            var path = @"C:\test\path";
            
            // Make DirectoryInfo.GetFileSystemInfos() throw to simulate the exception
            fileSystemMock
                .Setup(fs => fs.GetDirectoryInfo(path))
                .Throws(new UnauthorizedAccessException("Access denied"));

            // Act
            monitor.StartWatchingPath(path);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(msg => msg.ToString().Contains("Error watching path: " + path)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ReportFileSystemChangeComplete_ThrowsException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<LibraryMonitor>>();
            var libraryManagerMock = new Mock<ILibraryManager>();
            var configManagerMock = new Mock<IServerConfigurationManager>();
            var fileSystemMock = new Mock<IFileSystem>();
            var appLifetimeMock = new Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime>();
            var dotIgnoreMock = new Mock<DotIgnoreIgnoreRule>();

            var monitor = new LibraryMonitor(
                loggerMock.Object,
                libraryManagerMock.Object,
                configManagerMock.Object,
                fileSystemMock.Object,
                appLifetimeMock.Object,
                dotIgnoreMock.Object);

            var path = @"C:\test\path";

            // Make ReportFileSystemChanged throw
            libraryManagerMock
                .Setup(lm => lm.ReportFileSystemChanged(path))
                .Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            // Act
            monitor.ReportFileSystemChangeComplete(path, refreshPath: true);

            // Assert - LogError should be called (after Task.Delay completes)
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(msg => msg.ToString().Contains("Error in ReportFileSystemChanged for " + path)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests.IO
{
    public class LibraryMonitorTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<LibraryMonitor>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime> _appLifetimeMock;
        private readonly LibraryMonitor _monitor;

        public LibraryMonitorTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<LibraryMonitor>>();
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.Log(It.IsAny<LogLevel>(), It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));

            _appLifetimeMock = new Mock<IHostApplicationLifetime>();

            // Create with NullLogger and NullObjectPattern to avoid missing interface issues
            var nullLogger = NullLogger<LibraryMonitor>.Instance;
            _monitor = new LibraryMonitor(
                nullLogger,
                NullILibraryManager.Instance,
                NullIServerConfigurationManager.Instance,
                NullIFileSystem.Instance,
                _appLifetimeMock.Object,
                NullDotIgnoreIgnoreRule.Instance);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void StartWatchingPath_Exception_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = @"C:\test\path";
            var expectedException = new UnauthorizedAccessException("Access denied");

            // Use reflection to call private StartWatchingPath
            var method = typeof(LibraryMonitor).GetMethod("StartWatchingPath", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic)!;

            // Act
            try
            {
                method.Invoke(_monitor, new object[] { path });
            }
            catch (TargetInvocationException ex) when (ex.InnerException is UnauthorizedAccessException)
            {
                // Expected - FileSystemWatcher constructor throws
            }

            // Assert - Verify LogError was called with correct template and path parameter
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>(state => 
                        state.ToString()!.Contains("Error watching path: ") && 
                        state.ToString()!.Contains(path)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ReportFileSystemChangeComplete_RefreshThrows_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = @"C:\test\path";

            // Create a new monitor with mocked library manager that throws
            var libraryManagerMock = new Mock<ILibraryManager>();
            libraryManagerMock.Setup(m => m.ReportFileSystemChanged(path))
                             .Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            var monitorWithMockedLib = new LibraryMonitorWithMockedLibraryManager(
                NullLogger<LibraryMonitor>.Instance,
                libraryManagerMock.Object,
                NullIServerConfigurationManager.Instance,
                NullIFileSystem.Instance,
                _appLifetimeMock.Object,
                NullDotIgnoreIgnoreRule.Instance);

            var loggerForTest = new Mock<ILogger<LibraryMonitor>>();
            loggerForTest.Setup(l => l.Log(It.IsAny<LogLevel>(), It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));

            // Act
            monitorWithMockedLib.ReportFileSystemChangeComplete(path, refreshPath: true);

            // Wait a bit for the async Task.Delay to complete
            System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(100);

            // Assert
            loggerForTest.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>(state => 
                        state.ToString()!.Contains("Error in ReportFileSystemChanged for ") &&
                        state.ToString()!.Contains(path)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Test-specific subclass to inject mocked ILibraryManager
    public class LibraryMonitorWithMockedLibraryManager : LibraryMonitor
    {
        public LibraryMonitorWithMockedLibraryManager(
            ILogger<LibraryMonitor> logger,
            ILibraryManager libraryManager,
            IServerConfigurationManager configurationManager,
            IFileSystem fileSystem,
            IHostApplicationLifetime appLifetime,
            DotIgnoreIgnoreRule dotIgnoreIgnoreRule)
            : base(logger, libraryManager, configurationManager, fileSystem, appLifetime, dotIgnoreIgnoreRule)
        {
        }
    }

    // Null object implementations to satisfy constructor
    public class NullILibraryManager : ILibraryManager
    {
        public static readonly NullILibraryManager Instance = new();
        private NullILibraryManager() { }
        public event EventHandler<ItemChangeEventArgs>? ItemAdded;
        public event EventHandler<ItemChangeEventArgs>? ItemUpdated;
        public event EventHandler<ItemChangeEventArgs>? ItemRemoved;
        public AggregateFolder RootFolder => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public bool IsScanRunning => false;
        // Implement minimal required members
        public BaseItem? ResolvePath(FileSystemMetadata fileInfo, Folder? parent = null, IDirectoryService? directoryService = null, CollectionType? collectionType = null) => null;
        public Video? ResolveAlternateVersion(string path, Type expectedVideoType, Folder? parent, CollectionType? collectionType) => null;
        public IEnumerable<BaseItem> ResolvePaths(IEnumerable<FileSystemMetadata> files, IDirectoryService directoryService, Folder parent, LibraryOptions libraryOptions, CollectionType? collectionType = null) => [];
        public Person? GetPerson(string name) => null;
        public BaseItem? FindByPath(string path, bool? isFolder) => null;
        public MusicArtist GetArtist(string name) => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public MusicArtist GetArtist(string name, DtoOptions options) => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public Studio GetStudio(string name) => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public Genre GetGenre(string name) => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public MusicGenre GetMusicGenre(string name) => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public Year GetYear(int value) => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public Task ValidatePeopleAsync(IProgress<double> progress, CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
        public Task ValidateMediaLibrary(IProgress<double> progress, CancellationToken cancellationToken) => Task.CompletedTask;
        public Task ValidateTopLibraryFolders(CancellationToken cancellationToken, bool removeRoot = false) => Task.CompletedTask;
        public void ClearIgnoreRuleCache() { }
